content:
適用於 ManaMetal 的模組包。


旨在提升玩家的遊戲體驗，同時不影響 manametal 原有的遊戲玩法與額外內容。
此模組包包含多種輔助模組，能顯著改善玩家的整體遊戲體驗。

您可在此下載最新版 manametalmod：

https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/manametal

Manametalmod 官方 Discord：

https://Discord.Gg/JGTVQzD

模組清單：

FastCraft (by sfPlayer1)
Mob Spawning Fix (by tclproject)
Waila Harvestability (by squeek502)
ManaMetal (by 草莓龍醬)
NetherPortalFix (by BlayTheNinth)
CodeChickenCore Unofficial 1.7.10 (by mitchej123)
Biome Decoration Fix (by tclproject)
Waila (by profmobius)
CodeChickenLib Unofficial 1.7.10 (by mitchej123)
FTB Library (Forge) (Legacy) (by FTB)
FTB Utilities (Forge) (by FTB)
NotEnoughItems Unofficial 1.7.10 (by mitchej123)
Smooth Font (by bre2el)

 

在 Apex Host 取得您的 manametal 伺服器！
